license_required.quote: Every person desiring to practice medicine must, before beginning to practice, procure from the Board a license authorizing the person to practice.

type.quote: the Board shall, in the interest of the public, judiciously: (a) Enforce the provisions of this chapter

degree_required.value: Doctor of medicine from accredited medical school
degree_required.quote: Has received the degree of doctor of medicine from a medical school: (1) Approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education of the American Medical Association and Association of American Medical Colleges; or (2) Which provides a course of professional instruction equivalent to that provided in medical schools in the United States approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education

accrediting_body.value: Liaison Committee on Medical Education of the American Medical Association and Association of American Medical Colleges
accrediting_body.quote: Approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education of the American Medical Association and Association of American Medical Colleges

required.quote: Has completed 36 months of progressive postgraduate: (I) Education as a resident in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the Board, the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, the Collège des médecins du Québec or the College of Family Physicians of Canada, or, as applicable, their successor organizations; or (II) Fellowship training in the United States or Canada approved by the Board or the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

duration.quote: Has completed 36 months of progressive postgraduate

kind.quote: progressive postgraduate: (I) Education as a resident in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the Board, the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, the Collège des médecins du Québec or the College of Family Physicians of Canada, or, as applicable, their successor organizations; or (II) Fellowship training in the United States or Canada approved by the Board or the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

interval_years.quote: Biennial registration of the holder of a license to practice medicine

required.quote: The Board shall, as a prerequisite for the: (a) Renewal of a license as a physician assistant; (b) Renewal of a license as an anesthesiologist assistant; or (c) Biennial registration of the holder of a license to practice medicine, require each holder to submit evidence of compliance with the requirements for continuing education as set forth in regulations adopted by the Board.

value: Risk management in performance of medical services
Medical consequences of terrorism involving weapons of mass destruction (4 hours within 2 years after initial licensure)
Evidence-based suicide prevention and awareness (2 hours within 2 years after initial licensure, then 2 hours every 4 years)
Screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach to substance use disorder (2 hours within 2 years after initial licensure)
Cultural competency and diversity, equity and inclusion for psychiatrists (2 hours biennial)
Stigma, discrimination and unrecognized bias toward persons with HIV (2 hours within 2 years for certain physicians)
Substance use and opioid prescribing (2 hours per licensure period for those registered to dispense controlled substances)
topical_requirements.quote: These requirements: (a) May provide for the completion of one or more courses of instruction relating to risk management in the performance of medical services. (b) Must provide for the completion of a course of instruction, within 2 years after initial licensure, relating to the medical consequences of an act of terrorism that involves the use of a weapon of mass destruction... (c) Must provide for the completion by a holder of a license to practice medicine of a course of instruction within 2 years after initial licensure that provides at least 2 hours of instruction on evidence-based suicide prevention and awareness... (d) Must provide for the completion of at least 2 hours of training in the screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach to substance use disorder within 2 years after initial licensure.

available.quote: the Board may issue a license by endorsement to practice medicine to an applicant who has been issued a license to practice medicine by the District of Columbia or any state or territory of the United States

requirements.value: License must be in effect; applicant must meet statutory requirements for licensure except those in NRS 630.160; must submit proof of passage of approved examination; must meet fitness requirements; documentation must be authenticated
requirements.quote: At the time the applicant files an application with the Board, the license is in effect; (b) The applicant: (1) Submits to the Board proof of passage of an examination approved by the Board; (2) Submits to the Board any documentation and other proof of qualifications required by the Board; (3) Meets all of the statutory requirements for licensure to practice medicine in effect at the time of application except for the requirements set forth in NRS 630.160; and (4) Completes any additional requirements relating to the fitness of the applicant to practice required by the Board

exists.quote: the Board shall, in the interest of the public, judiciously: (a) Enforce the provisions of this chapter; (b) Establish by regulation standards for licensure under this chapter

title_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to... practice medicine, perfusion or respiratory care under a false or assumed name or falsely personate another licensee

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to... Except as otherwise provided by a specific statute, practice medicine, perfusion or respiratory care without being licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of medicine or the ability to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of medicine or the ability to practice medicine. A plea of nolo contendere is a conviction for the purposes of this subsection.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violating workers' compensation law provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of violating any of the provisions of NRS 616D.200, 616D.220, 616D.240, 616D.300, 616D.310, or 616D.350 to 616D.440, inclusive.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action taken by another state, federal government, foreign country or other jurisdiction, or surrender of license while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any disciplinary action, including, without limitation, the revocation, suspension, modification or limitation of a license to practice any type of medicine, taken by another state, the Federal Government, a foreign country or any other jurisdiction or the surrender of the license or discontinuing the practice of medicine while under investigation by any licensing authority, a medical facility, a branch of the Armed Services of the United States, an insurance company, an agency of the Federal Government or an employer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Malpractice, which may be evidenced by claims settled against a practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Malpractice, which may be evidenced by claims settled against a practitioner, but only if the malpractice is established by a preponderance of the evidence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any sexual activity with a patient who is currently being treated by the practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The engaging by a practitioner in any sexual activity with a patient who is currently being treated by the practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disruptive behavior with physicians, hospital personnel, patients, or others that interferes with patient care or adversely impacts quality of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disruptive behavior with physicians, hospital personnel, patients, members of the families of patients or any other persons if the behavior interferes with patient care or has an adverse impact on the quality of care rendered to a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that violates the trust of a patient and exploits the relationship for financial or other personal gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The engaging in conduct that violates the trust of a patient and exploits the relationship between the physician and the patient for financial or other personal gain.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to offer appropriate procedures or studies, to protest inappropriate denials by managed care organizations, to provide necessary services or to refer to appropriate provider
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to offer appropriate procedures or studies, to protest inappropriate denials by organizations for managed care, to provide necessary services or to refer a patient to an appropriate provider, when the failure occurs with the intent of positively influencing the financial well-being of the practitioner or an insurer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that brings the medical profession into disrepute, including violation of code of ethics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The engaging in conduct that brings the medical profession into disrepute, including, without limitation, conduct that violates any provision of a code of ethics adopted by the Board by regulation based on a national code of ethics.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual contact with the surrogate of a patient or other key persons related to a patient that exploits the relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The engaging in sexual contact with the surrogate of a patient or other key persons related to a patient, including, without limitation, a spouse, parent or legal guardian, which exploits the relationship between the physician and the patient in a sexual manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of murder, voluntary manslaughter, mayhem, felony involving firearm or deadly weapon, assault with intent to kill or sexual assault, sexual crimes, child abuse or neglect, controlled substance violations, or crimes involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of: (a) Murder, voluntary manslaughter or mayhem; (b) Any felony involving the use of a firearm or other deadly weapon; (c) Assault with intent to kill or to commit sexual assault or mayhem; (d) Sexual assault, statutory sexual seduction, incest, lewdness, indecent exposure or any other sexually related crime; (e) Abuse or neglect of a child or contributory delinquency; (f) A violation of any federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution or use of any controlled substance or any dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS; or (g) Any offense involving moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining, maintaining or renewing license by bribery, fraud or misrepresentation or by false, misleading, inaccurate or incomplete statement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining, maintaining or renewing or attempting to obtain, maintain or renew a license to practice medicine by bribery, fraud or misrepresentation or by any false, misleading, inaccurate or incomplete statement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising the practice of medicine in a false, deceptive or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising the practice of medicine in a false, deceptive or misleading manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or attempting to practice medicine under another name or falsely personate another licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or attempting to practice medicine under another name or falsely personate another licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing a blank prescription form
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing a blank prescription form.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Influencing a patient in order to engage in sexual activity with the patient or with others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Influencing a patient in order to engage in sexual activity with the patient or with others.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting directly or indirectly, by way of intimidation, coercion or deception, to obtain or retain a patient or to discourage the use of a second opinion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting directly or indirectly, by way of intimidation, coercion or deception, to obtain or retain a patient or to discourage the use of a second opinion.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Terminating the medical care of a patient without adequate notice or without making other arrangements for the continued care of the patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Terminating the medical care of a patient without adequate notice or without making other arrangements for the continued care of the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directly or indirectly receiving compensation intended or tending to influence the physician's objective evaluation or treatment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Directly or indirectly receiving from any person, corporation or other business organization any fee, commission, rebate or other form of compensation which is intended or tends to influence the physician's objective evaluation or treatment of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing a fee between licensees except where the patient is informed and the division is made in proportion to services performed and responsibility assumed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing a fee between licensees except where the patient is informed of the division of fees and the division of fees is made in proportion to the services personally performed and the responsibility assumed by each licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Referring a patient to a health facility, medical laboratory or commercial establishment in which the licensee has a financial interest in violation of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Referring, in violation of NRS 439B.425, a patient to a health facility, medical laboratory or commercial establishment in which the licensee has a financial interest.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging for visits to the physician's office which did not occur or for services which were not rendered or documented
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Charging for visits to the physician's office which did not occur or for services which were not rendered or documented in the records of the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, employing or advising any unlicensed person to engage in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, employing or advising, directly or indirectly, any unlicensed person to engage in the practice of medicine contrary to the provisions of this chapter or the regulations of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating responsibility for the care of a patient to a person if the licensee knows or has reason to know that the person is not qualified
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating responsibility for the care of a patient to a person if the licensee knows, or has reason to know, that the person is not qualified to undertake that responsibility.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose to a patient any financial or other conflict of interest
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to disclose to a patient any financial or other conflict of interest.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to initiate the performance of community service within 1 year after the date the community service is required to begin
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to initiate the performance of community service within 1 year after the date the community service is required to begin, if the community service was imposed as a requirement of the licensee's receiving loans or scholarships from the Federal Government or a state or local government for the licensee's medical education.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety because of illness, mental or physical condition or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics or other substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety because of illness, a mental or physical condition or the use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics or any other substance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any conduct which is intended to deceive or which violates standards of practice established by regulation of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any conduct: (1) Which is intended to deceive; (2) Which the Board has determined is a violation of the standards of practice established by regulation of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a provision of chapter 639 of NRS or a regulation adopted by the State Board of Pharmacy that is applicable to a licensee who is a practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Which is in violation of a provision of chapter 639 of NRS, or a regulation adopted by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant thereto, that is applicable to a licensee who is a practitioner, as defined in NRS 639.0125.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any controlled substance or dangerous drug to or for himself or herself or to others except as authorized by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any controlled substance, or any dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS, to or for himself or herself or to others except as authorized by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing, assisting or advising the injection of any substance containing liquid silicone into the human body, except for silicone oil to repair a retinal detachment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, assisting or advising the injection of any substance containing liquid silicone into the human body, except for the use of silicone oil to repair a retinal detachment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or performing services which the licensee knows or has reason to know that he or she is not competent to perform
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or performing services which the licensee knows or has reason to know that he or she is not competent to perform or which are beyond the scope of his or her training.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing, without first obtaining the informed consent of the patient or the patient's family, any procedure or prescribing any therapy which by the current standards of the practice of medicine is experimental
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, without first obtaining the informed consent of the patient or the patient's family, any procedure or prescribing any therapy which by the current standards of the practice of medicine is experimental.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continual failure to exercise the skill or diligence or use the methods ordinarily exercised under the same circumstances by physicians in good standing practicing in the same specialty or field
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continual failure to exercise the skill or diligence or use the methods ordinarily exercised under the same circumstances by physicians in good standing practicing in the same specialty or field.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report which the licensee or applicant knows to be false or failing to file a record or report as required by law or regulation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report which the licensee or applicant knows to be false or failing to file a record or report as required by law or regulation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with the requirements of NRS 630.254 regarding notification of address changes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with the requirements of NRS 630.254.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure by a licensee or applicant to report in writing, within 30 days, any disciplinary action taken against the licensee or applicant by another state, the Federal Government or a foreign country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a licensee or applicant to report in writing, within 30 days, any disciplinary action taken against the licensee or applicant by another state, the Federal Government or a foreign country, including, without limitation, the revocation, suspension or surrender of a license to practice medicine in another jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure by a licensee or applicant to report in writing, within 30 days, any criminal action taken or conviction obtained against the licensee or applicant, other than a minor traffic violation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a licensee or applicant to report in writing, within 30 days, any criminal action taken or conviction obtained against the licensee or applicant, other than a minor traffic violation, in this State or any other state or by the Federal Government, a branch of the Armed Forces of the United States or any local or federal jurisdiction of a foreign country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to be found competent to practice medicine as a result of an examination to determine medical competency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to be found competent to practice medicine as a result of an examination to determine medical competency pursuant to NRS 630.318.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Operation of a medical facility at any time during which the license of the facility is suspended or revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Operation of a medical facility at any time during which: (1) The license of the facility is suspended or revoked; or (2) An act or omission occurs which results in the suspension or revocation of the license pursuant to NRS 449.160.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the requirements of NRS 630.373 regarding administration of anesthesia or sedation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of NRS 630.373.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any act that is unsafe or unprofessional conduct in accordance with regulations adopted by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any act that is unsafe or unprofessional conduct in accordance with regulations adopted by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or willfully procuring or administering a controlled substance or dangerous drug that is not approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration, unless procured through a licensed pharmacy, Canadian pharmacy, used for medical cannabis, or is an investigational treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly or willfully procuring or administering a controlled substance or a dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS that is not approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration, unless the unapproved controlled substance or dangerous drug: (1) Was procured through a retail pharmacy licensed pursuant to chapter 639 of NRS; (2) Was procured through a Canadian pharmacy which is licensed pursuant to chapter 639 of NRS and which has been recommended by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant to subsection 4 of NRS 639.2328; (3) Is cannabis being used for medical purposes in accordance with chapter 678C of NRS; or (4) Is an individualized investigational treatment or investigational drug or biological product prescribed to a patient pursuant to NRS 630.3735 or 633.6945.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to supervise adequately a medical assistant pursuant to the regulations of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to supervise adequately a medical assistant pursuant to the regulations of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the provisions of NRS 630.3745 regarding pelvic examinations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the provisions of NRS 630.3745.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to obtain any training required by the Board pursuant to NRS 630.2535
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to obtain any training required by the Board pursuant to NRS 630.2535.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the provisions of NRS 454.217 or 629.086 regarding safe injection practices or dermal fillers
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the provisions of NRS 454.217 or 629.086.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the provisions of NRS 441A.315 or any regulations adopted pursuant thereto
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the provisions of NRS 441A.315 or any regulations adopted pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or supervising the performance of a pelvic examination in violation of NRS 629.085
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing or supervising the performance of a pelvic examination in violation of NRS 629.085.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain timely, legible, accurate and complete medical records relating to the diagnosis, treatment and care of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain timely, legible, accurate and complete medical records relating to the diagnosis, treatment and care of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Altering medical records of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report which the licensee knows to be false, failing to file a record or report as required by law, or knowingly or willfully obstructing or inducing another to obstruct such filing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report which the licensee knows to be false, failing to file a record or report as required by law or knowingly or willfully obstructing or inducing another to obstruct such filing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to make the medical records of a patient available for inspection and copying as provided in NRS 629.061
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to make the medical records of a patient available for inspection and copying as provided in NRS 629.061, if the licensee is the custodian of health care records with respect to those records.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the requirements of NRS 630.3068 regarding malpractice reporting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of NRS 630.3068.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report any person the licensee knows, or has reason to know, is in violation of the provisions of this chapter or the regulations of the Board within 30 days after the date the licensee knows or has reason to know of the violation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report any person the licensee knows, or has reason to know, is in violation of the provisions of this chapter, except for a violation of NRS 630.2672, or the regulations of the Board within 30 days after the date the licensee knows or has reason to know of the violation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the requirements of NRS 453.163, 453.164, 453.226, 639.23507, 639.23535 and 639.2391 to 639.23916, inclusive, and any regulations adopted by the State Board of Pharmacy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of NRS 453.163, 453.164, 453.226, 639.23507, 639.23535 and 639.2391 to 639.23916, inclusive, and any regulations adopted by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a controlled substance listed in schedule II, III or IV
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a controlled substance listed in schedule II, III or IV.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or willfully disclosing a communication privileged pursuant to a statute or court order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly or willfully disclosing a communication privileged pursuant to a statute or court order.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or willfully failing to comply with a regulation, subpoena or order of the Board or a committee designated by the Board to investigate a complaint
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 630.2672, knowingly or willfully failing to comply with: (a) A regulation, subpoena or order of the Board or a committee designated by the Board to investigate a complaint against a physician; (b) A court order relating to this chapter; or (c) A provision of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or willfully failing to perform a statutory or other legal obligation imposed upon a licensed physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 457.301 and 630.2672, knowingly or willfully failing to perform a statutory or other legal obligation imposed upon a licensed physician, including a violation of the provisions of NRS 439B.410.

definition_quote.value: To diagnose, treat, correct, prevent or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality, including, but not limited to, the performance of an autopsy. To apply principles or techniques of medical science in the diagnosis or the prevention of any such conditions. To perform any of the acts described in subsections 1 and 2 by using equipment that transfers information concerning the medical condition of the patient electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including, without limitation, through telehealth, from within or outside this State or the United States. To offer, undertake, attempt to do or hold oneself out as able to do any of the acts described in subsections 1 and 2.

methods_authorized.quote: To diagnose, treat, correct, prevent or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality, including, but not limited to, the performance of an autopsy... by using equipment that transfers information concerning the medical condition of the patient electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including, without limitation, through telehealth

drug_authority.quote: To diagnose, treat, correct, prevent or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental

license_status_types.quote: A locum tenens license... A special license... A restricted license... A temporary license... A special purpose license... an authorized facility license... a limited license to practice medicine as a resident physician

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical school graduates must submit proof of the degree of doctor of medicine or its equivalent as determined by the Board, and the standard certificate of the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates or a written statement from that Commission that the applicant passed the examination given by the Commission
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: an applicant for a license to practice medicine who is a graduate of a foreign medical school shall submit to the Board proof that the applicant has received: (a) The degree of doctor of medicine or its equivalent, as determined by the Board; and (b) The standard certificate of the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates or a written statement from that Commission that the applicant passed the examination given by the Commission.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Has completed 36 months of progressive postgraduate

pain_management_education_required.quote: The Board shall, by regulation, require each physician or physician assistant who is registered to dispense controlled substances pursuant to NRS 453.231 to complete at least 2 hours of training relating specifically to persons with substance use and other addictive disorders and the prescribing of opioids during each period of licensure.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Physicians may prescribe controlled substances for the treatment of intractable pain in accordance with NRS 639.23507 and 639.2391 to 639.23916, inclusive, and any regulations adopted by the State Board of Pharmacy and the Board of Medical Examiners
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Prescribing or administering to a patient under his or her care a controlled substance which is listed in schedule II, III, IV or V by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant to NRS 453.146, if the controlled substance is lawfully prescribed or administered for the treatment of intractable pain in accordance with the provisions of NRS 639.23507 and 639.2391 to 639.23916, inclusive, any regulations adopted by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant thereto and any other regulations adopted by the Board of Medical Examiners.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: The Board shall, by regulation, require each physician or physician assistant who is registered to dispense controlled substances pursuant to NRS 453.231 to complete at least 2 hours of training relating specifically to persons with substance use and other addictive disorders and the prescribing of opioids during each period of licensure.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Physicians may perform acts described in the practice of medicine by using equipment that transfers information concerning the medical condition of the patient electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including, without limitation, through telehealth, from within or outside this State or the United States
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: To perform any of the acts described in subsections 1 and 2 by using equipment that transfers information concerning the medical condition of the patient electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including, without limitation, through telehealth, from within or outside this State or the United States.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: A special purpose license to a physician who is licensed in another state to perform any of the acts described in subsections 1 and 2 of NRS 630.020 by using equipment that transfers information concerning the medical condition of a patient in this State electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including, without limitation, through telehealth, from within or outside this State or the United States.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: A temporary license for a specified period if the physician is licensed and in good standing in another state and meets the requirements for licensure in this State, and if the Board determines that it is necessary in order to provide medical services for a community without adequate medical care. A temporary license issued pursuant to the provisions of this paragraph is not renewable.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: the Board shall submit to the Governor and to the Director of the Legislative Counsel Bureau for transmittal to the next regular session of the Legislature a written report compiling: (a) Disciplinary action taken by the Board during the previous biennium against any licensee for malpractice or negligence; (b) Information reported to the Board during the previous biennium pursuant to NRS 630.3067, 630.3068, subsections 3 and 6 of NRS 630.307 and NRS 690B.250

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: Require the person to participate in a program to correct an alcohol or other substance use disorder

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: If the Board or any investigative committee of the Board has reason to believe that the conduct of any physician, physician assistant, practitioner of respiratory care or perfusionist has raised a reasonable question as to his or her competence to practice medicine, respiratory care or perfusion or practice as a physician assistant, as applicable, with reasonable skill and safety to patients, or if the Board has received a report pursuant to the provisions of NRS 630.3067, 630.3068 or 690B.250 indicating that a judgment has been rendered or an award has been made against a physician, physician assistant, practitioner of respiratory care or perfusionist regarding an action or claim for malpractice or that such an action or claim against the physician, physician assistant, practitioner of respiratory care or perfusionist has been resolved by settlement, the Board or committee may order that the physician, physician assistant, practitioner of respiratory care or perfusionist undergo a mental or physical examination, an examination testing his or her competence to practice medicine, respiratory care or perfusion or practice as a physician assistant, as applicable, or any other examination designated by the Board to assist the Board or committee in determining the fitness of the physician, physician assistant, practitioner of respiratory care or perfusionist to practice medicine, respiratory care or perfusion or practice as a physician assistant, as applicable.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: A person may apply to the Board to be licensed as an administrative physician if the person meets all of the statutory requirements for licensure in effect at the time of application except the requirements of paragraph (c) of subsection 2 of NRS 630.160... A person who is licensed as an administrative physician pursuant to this section: (a) May not engage in the practice of clinical medicine; (b) Shall comply with all of the statutory requirements for continued licensure pursuant to this chapter; and (c) Shall be deemed to hold a license to practice medicine in an administrative capacity only.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A locum tenens license, to be effective not more than 3 months after issuance, to any physician who is licensed and in good standing in another state, who meets the requirements for licensure in this State and who is of good moral character and reputation. The purpose of this license is to enable an eligible physician to serve as a substitute for another physician who is licensed to practice medicine in this State and who is absent from his or her practice for reasons deemed sufficient by the Board.

investigational_drug_protection.quote: A physician may prescribe or recommend an individualized investigational treatment or investigational drug, biological product or device to a patient if the physician has: (a) Diagnosed the patient with a life-threatening or severely debilitating disease or condition; (b) Discussed with the patient all available methods of treating the life-threatening or severely debilitating disease or condition that have been approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration and the patient and the physician have determined that no such method of treatment is adequate to treat the life-threatening or severely debilitating disease or condition of the patient... A physician is not subject to disciplinary action for prescribing or recommending an individualized investigational treatment or investigational drug, biological product or device when authorized to do so pursuant to subsection 1.
